name: GemiDice
tagline: A text adventure where Gemini runs the story as dungeon master and dice rolls decide your fate.
problem: The team wanted to combine tabletop role-play and early text adventures.
solution: Gemini sets the scene and asks for dice rolls; failures cost health; themes change the look and mood; ElevenLabs adds voice and sound.
demo_moment: Team-described: propose a risky action and roll for it.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[MLH] Best Use of .Tech” among 217 submissions.

lessons: A dice roll gives an LLM game stakes and structure.
